threat_event: Attacker manipulates pipeline SCADA to change pressures or valve positions on the trunk line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trunk line SCADA reachable through the shared jump servers and historian connector (GR-01, GR-02); controllers not trained on SCADA manipulation
existing_controls: Pressure relief and overpressure protection independent of SCADA; OT sensors at the PCC
treatment_plan: Division-only access paths (GR-01, GR-02); SCADA manipulation as an abnormal operating condition in controller training (ML-003)

threat_event: The backup PCC does not work when the main PCC is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup SCADA test last done 2025-04-22, past the 15-month limit in 195.446(c)(4) (scenario gap 4)
existing_controls: Replicated SCADA servers at the backup PCC
treatment_plan: Test the backup SCADA system by 2026-10-31 and then every calendar year within 15 months (POAM-015)

threat_event: Controllers respond slowly or wrongly when SCADA is lost or manipulated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controller training does not cover loss or manipulation of SCADA as an abnormal operating condition (scenario gap 4)
existing_controls: Annual controller training and tabletop exercises for hydraulic events
treatment_plan: Add SCADA loss and manipulation scenarios to training and the simulator (POAM-017)

threat_event: A SCADA display shows the wrong field device or value after the 2026-03 expansion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-to-point verification records incomplete after the 2026-03 SCADA expansion (scenario gap 4)
treatment_plan: Re-verify the 2026-03 points and record results (POAM-016)

threat_event: A gathering line release is not detected because computational leak detection is disrupted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Leak detection depends on SCADA data; about 2,300 miles of gathering lines
treatment_plan: Leak detection outage procedure with patrols of high-consequence segments

threat_event: Ransomware stops truck dispatch and electronic run tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-M3 on provider A; drivers depend on the run ticket app
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups; paper run tickets and radio dispatch
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test; paper ticket stock at regional terminals

threat_event: An attacker uses dispatch or telematics data to divert or steal crude loads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The hazmat security plan risk assessment does not cover cyber threats to dispatch, run tickets, and telematics (scenario gap 5)
existing_controls: Physical en route security measures; driver check-ins
treatment_plan: Add cyber en route threats to the security plan risk assessment; update in-depth security training (POAM-018)

threat_event: Drivers are disciplined on AI camera scores that are wrong or biased
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver-facing camera AI event scores feed discipline without review (scenario gap 5)
treatment_plan: Human review of every scored event before discipline; accuracy audit by route and shift (P10; POAM-022)

threat_event: Shipper confidential volumes and statements are exposed through the shipper portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 85 shippers share one portal; access is per shipper user
existing_controls: MFA for portal users; role-based access per shipper
treatment_plan: Authorization tests every release; annual penetration test (SOC 2 readiness, P09)

threat_event: Someone tampers with a LACT flow computer to misstate custody volumes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 LACT units at remote sites
existing_controls: Seals; proving schedules; flow computer audit logs
treatment_plan: Monthly comparison of flow computer configuration with the approved baseline

threat_event: The telematics vendor suffers a breach that exposes driver location and video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,900 drivers; video and GPS data held by the vendor
treatment_plan: Breach notice terms at renewal; video retention limit

threat_event: Crude Logistics cannot show shippers or auditors which controls it inherits from corporate
owner: Crude Logistics security and compliance lead

threat_event: Division procedures conflict with group policy
owner: Crude Logistics security and compliance lead

threat_event: A PHMSA 1-hour or EPA immediate notice is missed while the PCC is isolated during a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release reporting depends on PCC facts; reporting-regulated-only gathering lines follow different rules
existing_controls: Emergency procedures under 195.402; National Response Center number in the control room
treatment_plan: Offline notice checklist at the PCC and backup PCC; include in the cross-division tabletop
